label: spec-kit-check: main job 867s (CLI vitest 490s, legacy lanes 161s, install 73s, runtime vitest 79s), doctor job 200s, mirrors 83s
comment-hygiene costs 92s per run with 87s of it a full-history checkout for a checker that runs in about one second
naming-standard-guard costs 88s with 72s checkout plus a Python install for a filename scan
agent-mirror-sync costs 85s: 69s checkout, 10s build, about one second of checking
message-contract costs 78s with 72s checkout, so narrowing inside the job saves no measurable time
routing-registry-drift costs 256s across two jobs: 113s checkout, 73s provisioning, 37s of ratchet suites
